domain: national statistical office - aggregate time series (parked as a source class, not a single dataset)
prediction_question: Hypothetical tasks this publisher class would support (parked): direction/level forecasts on StatCan's own aggregate series (e.g. will monthly table X rise next period), or cross-sectional prediction on a public-use microdata file (PUMF) survey snapshot. Neither class is being taken to construction; see rejection_reason.
prediction_time: Would be the publication date of the prior reference period for an aggregate forecast - stateable, but the task class is the problem, not the timing.
target_definition: Not fixed (parked before one was chosen): aggregate-series direction labels or same-survey PUMF outcomes - both are documented classes with known problems (see rejection_reason).

sources.name: Statistics Canada Web Data Service (WDS) - developer documentation
sources.api: anonymous REST: 'Our Web Data Service gives developers access to Statistics Canada data via the following 15 methods: getChangedSeriesList, getChangedCubeList, getCubeMetadata, getSeriesInfoFromCubePidCoord, getSerie...' plus 'The Statistics Canada SDMX REST web services provide access to the time series made available on the Statistics Canada's website' - no API key mentioned anywhere on the page (measured 2026-10-21, HTTP 200, 22,322 bytes).
sources.license: StatCan publishes under the Open Government Licence - Canada (OGL-CA 2.0) family; per-table licence to be quoted at candidate level if ever unparked.
sources.access: measured 2026-10-21: docs page HTTP 200 anonymous; the WDS is documented and key-free. Access is NOT the blocker.

sources.name: Statistics Canada data catalogue (tables list)
sources.api: HTML catalogue, anonymous: '13,356 results' data tables plus a distinct 'Public use microdata (158)' results class (measured 2026-10-21, HTTP 200, 135,545 bytes); includes series (e.g. Table 33-10-0036-01 daily FX rates, 27 series from 1981) and directly-downloadable public-use microdata files (e.g. 'National Travel Survey microdata file Public use microdata: 24-25-0001', with monthly files 'available back to 2006 and can be directly downloaded' and earlier periods by EFT request).
sources.license: OGL-CA family; PUMF files carry their own terms.

license_evidence.note: Not the blocker; StatCan's open tables are published under the Government of Canada's open-licence family. The microdata index (statcan.gc.ca/en/microdata/index) returned HTTP 500 on 2026-10-21 (recorded as a probe result, not silence); gated microdata channels (Research Data Centres) are known to require application and restrict redistribution. No licence question was escalated because the park does not turn on licence.

split_strategy: Not measured beyond the probes above: the park is at the source-class level, before any single table was selected. Aggregate series would trivially fill temporal windows (daily/monthly series back to the 1980s), but window-filling is not the binding constraint here.

measurements.probes_2026_10_21: WDS docs page: HTTP 200, 22,322 bytes, 15 documented REST methods + SDMX, no API key, anonymous. Catalogue page: HTTP 200, 135,545 bytes, 13,356 data tables plus a distinct 'Public use microdata (158)' class (Labour Force Survey PUMF among them). Microdata index page: HTTP 500 (measured failure, recorded). No table was downloaded; no cost was incurred beyond three page fetches.
measurements.source_class_analysis: Every open StatCan product found by these probes falls into one of two classes: (a) aggregate time series (13,356-table catalogue; daily/monthly/annual series by province/industry/etc.) whose natural task is a direction-forecast on the series' own history - the family already served by M4/Monash-style macro benchmarks, thinned further by the fact that the publisher's own seasonal adjustment and commentary ship with the table; or (b) cross-sectional survey PUMF snapshots (e.g. National Travel Survey 24-25-0001) whose natural task is a same-survey outcome prediction - the census-income/adult-data family, the most mirrored task class in public ML. Same-shape verdict as the ONS park of 2026-10-21 (ons-la-claimant-count-direction): an aggregate-statistics publisher with registration-gated microdata.
measurements.canada_tick_recheck_2026_10_30: Both named unpark checks re-run on this Canada tick (partially duplicating the 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-27 runs recorded in notes.md, which the record's next_action had not been updated to reflect): (1) WDS getChangedCubeList ANSWERS at https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/wds/rest/getChangedCubeList/<ISO date> - CORRECTING the 2026-10-27 note that recorded the method as missing/404: measured 2026-10-29 -> 99 changed products (productId+releaseTime), 2026-10-28 -> 36, 2026-10-30 -> empty (not yet posted). The feed's grain is the aggregate table/cube (productId), so this channel cannot surface a case/event-grain release; the correction changes the endpoint record, not the verdict. (2) open.canada.ca StatCan feed: 10,268 packages in org 'statcan' (CKAN q=organization:statcan); the 500 most recently modified packages (2026-09-23 to 2026-10-22) scanned - every 'case'/'incident'/'claim'/'licence' title hit is an aggregate cross-tab (youth/adult criminal court case-count tables, police-reported cybercrime/hate-crime counts, EI claims by province, cyber-security-incident survey aggregates, vehicles entering Canada by licence-plate type). No case/event-grain release. Conclusion: unpark condition still not met; the source-class park stands.

rejection_reason: PARKED as a source class: StatCan's open catalogue is aggregate series (direction-forecast-on-own-history family, low agent-eval value, prior art M4/Monash) plus cross-sectional survey snapshots (census-income family, already mirrored publicly); the case/event-grain products (UCR microdata, RDC files) are registration-gated and not redistributable. This mirrors the recorded ONS verdict and prevents the tick's named 'Statistics Canada' from consuming a construction slot on a task class the bench has already judged thin.
next_action: Parked. Unpark only if an open case/event-grain StatCan release appears (per-month incident- or record-level data with a documented schema, no registration wall). The named checks were run 2026-10-22, 2026-10-27 and again 2026-10-30 (see notes.md and measurements) - all negative; getChangedCubeList's working path is /t1/wds/rest/getChangedCubeList/<date> and its grain is aggregate cubes. A future Canada tick should re-check only the open.canada.ca feed's newest packages, not the WDS change feed.
